subject: Shared success runbook & 90-day timeline - Spectralix
messages:
From: Alex Lewis <alex.lewis@spectralix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Shared success runbook + timeline (Spectralix)

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency/throughput profile and the quantization options you showed. Procurement asked me to share the SOW and outline a practical timeline so they can align internal approvals. Attached: Spectralix-SOW-v0.pdf (SOW draft).

High level from our side: we want a low-friction kickoff, validated integration with our existing request routing, and a hard go-live target before Sept 1. Our initial ask: a 90-day rollout covering staging integration, validation, and production ramp.

Can you share a lightweight runbook (milestones, owners, dates) we can review before the kickoff? Also please highlight any gating items (certs, account provisioning, or procurement milestones) your team needs so we can loop the right folks.

Alex
Alex Lewis
Head of Platform Engineering, Spectralix
alex.lewis@spectralix.com

Attachment: Spectralix-SOW-v0.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lewis <alex.lewis@spectralix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared success runbook + timeline (Spectralix)

Alex — thanks and appreciated.

Attached is a first-pass runbook (Spectralix-MAP-draft.xlsx). I kept it intentionally compact: 7 milestone buckets across 90 days with owners and acceptance criteria. Quick highlights:

- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): account provisioning, RBAC and KMS handshake (owner: Naomi)
- Weeks 1–3: staging integration and routing tests (owner: Naomi + Spectralix eng)
- Weeks 4–6: live traffic validation (canary) + cost profiling (owner: Marissa)
- Weeks 7–12: performance tuning, training-triggered fallbacks and SLA acceptance (owner: Marissa)

Gating items we flagged that will need action from Spectralix:
- KMS access and key rotation policy (procurement/security sign-off)
- Proof-of-concept traffic sample for batching profile (we'll provide a template)
- Procurement review for reserved capacity if you want predictable throughput (optional)

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Jun 3, 2025 10:00 AM PT — short 30-minute alignment to confirm owners and deliverables. Calendar link in my next note if that works.

If you want, Marissa can add a short implementation owner slate (who does what) to the runbook before the kickoff.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachment: Spectralix-MAP-draft.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Alex Lewis <alex.lewis@spectralix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Shared success runbook + timeline (Spectralix)

Thanks Irene — this looks exactly like what we need. Jun 3 at 10am PT works for the engineering and product leads.

Couple of notes from procurement: they will need a clear list of deliverables tied to milestones and a draft procurement timeline (we'll push legal the week after kickoff). Would you be able to add a short procurement column in the runbook listing approval owners and expected sign dates?

Also looping procurement: procurement@spectralix.com — they will help track internal approvals.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Lewis <alex.lewis@spectralix.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation owners and gating — Spectralix runbook

Alex / team — quick note to call out owners and an explicit acceptance checklist so procurement can see traceability. We've translated Irene's buckets into deliverables and owners below (short view):

- Pre-kickoff (by Jun 2): KMS handshake completed; account provisioning in staging; contact list confirmed. Owner: Naomi Feldman (CS Ops).
- Integration sprint (Jun 3–Jun 23): API routing tests, sample payloads, batching profile captured. Owners: Naomi (Redwood) + Spectralix Eng (Alex). Acceptance: 1000 requests runbooked, latency within agreed band.
- Canary window (Jun 24–Jul 8): 5% traffic, monitoring dashboard live, cost telemetry enabled. Owner: Marissa Cole (Implementation Lead). Acceptance: no P0 incidents for 72h, baseline cost < 1.2x estimate.
- Ramp & tuning (Jul 9–Aug 31): performance tuning, fallback configuration, run-rate stress. Owners: Marissa + Redwood infra. Acceptance: SLA acceptance test passed, runbook turned over to CS.

Procurement column we recommend: expected internal approval (Legal sign-off) by Jun 17; reserved capacity decision by Jun 24 (if selected).

I added a short PDF (90-day-runbook-v1.pdf) that flattens the spreadsheet into a one-page timeline and owner roster for exec review.

Kickoff: Tue, Jun 3, 10:00 AM PT — short agenda: 1) Introductions and confirm owners (10 min), 2) Walk the runbook and gating (10 min), 3) Next steps and immediate asks (10 min). I put a calendar invite on the link below.

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/0abcdef123456/kickoff-20250603-1000-PT

Marissa
